review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Network Engineer is responsible for design, provision, installation/configuration, operation, and maintenance of systems hardware and software and related infrastructure. Will also input to network architecture to ensure appropriate technology strategy to meet business requirements. Troubleshoot and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless controllers. Maintain documentation and infrastructure diagrams. Job Qualifications Networking**: Cisco Nexus (NX-OS), Catalyst, ASR/ISR, SD-WA
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Will also input to network architecture to ensure appropriate technology strategy to meet business requirements. This individual should be a highly qualified network with up-to-date hands-on skills. Job Qualifications Networking**: Cisco Nexus (NX-OS), Catalyst, ASR/ISR, SD-WAN, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VLANs, MPLS. Experience 5+ years of experience in enterprise networks or managed service environments. Strong hands‑on expertise in Cisco environments; CCNP Enterprise required . Proficient in troubleshooting with network tools and debuggers.

review_candidates.title: Remote IT Systems Administrator — Cloud & Virtualization
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Intelligent Technical Solutions is seeking a collaborative System Administrator to deliver remote IT support, manage system updates, and troubleshoot client issues. You will maintain servers, virtualization, and provide after-hours on-call support to ensure service quality. 3+ years in IT support with Windows and Mac OS troubleshooting, plus experience with Server 2016–2025, VMware/Hyper-V, Azure and M365, are preferred.
